summary: Public projects created on 27 July 2026: 4 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Webcam-driven adaptive screen brightness for KDE Plasma on Wayland, an unofficial changelog of Israel's open data portal, and planning notes for SIP phone service in Israel are among the repositories. A reference dataset covers storage container dimensions for European and North American warehouses.
